validity.recommendation: No change to existence/classification/duplicate status. P5541 ('Ukhta-Torzhok (Vuktyl) Gas Pipeline', segment I) is a real, currently-operating 1220mm magistral gas transmission line, built 1967-1969 as the Ukhta-Torzhok leg of the Soviet-era 'Siyanie Severa' system carrying Vuktyl-field gas from Komi Republic to the Torzhok hub in Tver Oblast. DUPLICATE/NAME-COLLISION CHECK: Gazprom's own project-design encyclopedia page (proektirovanie.gazprom.ru) explicitly and independently distinguishes this Vuktyl-era trio ('Ukhta - Torzhok, I, II, III нитки' = P5541/P5542/P5543) from the separate, newer Yamal-corridor 'Ukhta-Torzhok II (Yamal)' system (a different GEM row family), confirming no duplicate-entity risk between the two same-named groups. One MISMATCHED wiki-citation finding: gem.wiki's harvested citation list for this page includes energybase.ru/pipeline/punga-vuktyl-ukhta, which on inspection is about a DIFFERENT pipeline ('Pipeline Punga-Vuktyl-Ukhta I, II', 1420mm/1976) sharing only the Vuktyl origin -- correctly excluded from this shard's refs rather than cited. CAVEAT (not an existence/status change now, but material for the next review cycle): an Apr-2025 Komiinform article quotes Gazprom Transgaz Ukhta's CEO stating Gazprom's leadership has decided to dismantle both 'Ukhta-Torzhok 1' and 'Ukhta-Torzhok 2' lines as part of a system-optimization project on the Ukhta-Gryazovets section (framed as the least energy-efficient lines on the network) -- see status_reviews[] for the full detail and forward-looking flag.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Status itself (operating) is CONFIRMED current and correct -- no evidence anywhere in this research pass suggests the line is idle, decommissioned, or under active dismantling as of the review date. FORWARD-LOOKING FLAG FOR THE NEXT REVIEW CYCLE (not actioned now): the same Apr-2025 komiinform.ru article reports that Gazprom's leadership has already DECIDED to dismantle both 'Ukhta-Torzhok 1' (=P5541, this row) and 'Ukhta-Torzhok 2' (=P5542, sibling row) as part of a two-phase optimization project on the Ukhta-Gryazovets section, explicitly because they are the least energy-efficient lines on the network ('эта система ... является наименее энергоэффективной на предприятии'). No article read gives a firm dismantling start date, timeline, or confirms it has begun -- the plan is described as a decision/announcement, not yet an executed action, so 'confirm' (not 'change' to shelved/decommissioning) is the correct verdict today. STRONGLY RECOMMEND the next annual review of this row specifically re-check for dismantling progress, since this is a rare case of an operator publicly pre-announcing a decommissioning decision for a currently-operating line. This same caveat applies to sibling row P5542 (Ukhta-Torzhok II) -- see cross_row_leads.
